title: geranium purpureum subsp. forsteri
intro: Geranium purpureum subsp. forsteri, commonly known as the New Zealand geranium or Forster's geranium, is a plant species in the family Geraniaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with benefits including relief from anxiety, insomnia, and stress, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and improve overall cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Geranium purpureum subsp. forsteri include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it a valuable remedy for promoting relaxation and reducing muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of this plant include geraniin, geraniol, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional herbal medicine.
